previous_notes.text: Patient presented with elevated PSA of 4.0 ng/mL. Initial discussion regarding the need for tissue sampling was held. Decision was made to proceed with a systematic biopsy to rule out malignancy.

pathology_report:
Biopsy timepoint 1:
Histological examination of the initial biopsy specimen reveals benign prostatic tissue. The Gleason score is 0+0, corresponding to ISUP grade group 0. No cribriform or intraductal patterns are identified. Perineural invasion is not present.

Biopsy timepoint 2:
The subsequent biopsy specimen demonstrates adenocarcinoma with an acinar growth pattern. The Gleason score is 3+4, corresponding to ISUP grade group 2. No cribriform or intraductal patterns are identified. Perineural invasion is present. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone, bilaterally.

The histological trajectory across timepoints shows an upgrade from benign findings to ISUP grade group 2 adenocarcinoma.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): Timepoint 1 — grade group 4; Timepoint 2 — grade group 3.
